name: What is the process for replacing a sliding patio door?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for replacing a sliding patio door?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process generally begins with an initial consultation and measurement, followed by ordering the new door. Once the door arrives, the installation involves removing the old door and frame, inspecting and preparing the rough opening, installing the new door unit square and plumb, sealing and insulating gaps, and finally, installing interior and exterior trim. A final inspection ensures proper operation and finishes. Reputable contractors will also ensure proper clean-up.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, ordering, old door removal, opening preparation, new door installation, sealing, trimming, and a final inspection.
